B.13 (Major Langdon)        B.4.c (Mr. Pilkington)

I attach copy of letter, ECW/KV/1096 of June 10th, from Whetmore, with reference to the LOEWEHNEIM brothers.

The two photographs of the LOEWEHNEIM brothers are likewise returned herewith.

12.6.41.

for Lieut. Colonel Hinchley Cooke.
